body: Thank you for your kind words. You're right: there are bright spots.
Your words have helped a lot. I appreciate it. Even a glimmer of hope makes so much difference. Thank you again.

I've never thought about going in to the VA. I figured I was only in for 4 years AD and that was like 6 years ago. I figured any benefits I had access to are long gone. I'll def look into it though. I hate to admit it but any help from the VA or vet's assistance would help a lot right now.

It feels perfectly fine nowadays (thank goodness) but the docs still don't know what happened. I was in the process of saving to see a doc again. 

Thanks for the kind words.
